articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Parker-Hannifin Expands Filtration Reach As Valuation And Guidance Draw Focus. Parker-Hannifin (NYSE:PH) has agreed to acquire Filtration Group Corporation, expanding its presence in life sciences, HVAC, and industrial markets. The company reported record quarterly sales alongside strong organic growth in key segments. Management raised full-year guidance following the Filtration Group announcement and the latest quarterly results. articles.title: Analyst Report: Parker-Hannifin Corp.
articles.summary: Argus Research: Analyst Report: Parker-Hannifin Corp.. Parker Hannifin manufactures motion and control technologies and systems that are used to control fluids, gas, or air in hydraulic, pneumatic and vacuum applications. It sells its products to aerospace, commercial, and industrial customers, who use them to move materials and operate machines and vehicles. The company employs approximately 58,000 people. PH shares are a component of the S&P 500. Related tickers mentioned: ^GSPC.
